name: 409ai
description: Answers about 409A and other private-company valuations from 409.AI's published guides, FAQs and articles, with the source page cited.

interface.longDescription:
409.AI helps startups and private companies get expert-reviewed valuation reports: 409A, QSBS attestation, ASC 718, ASC 820, IFRS 2, gift and estate tax, ESOP, UK EMI and CSOP, purchase price allocation, impairment testing and IP valuations.

This plugin answers questions using 409.AI's published content only: the blog, the 409A valuation guide, the FAQs, the product and pricing pages, and the list of information a valuation needs. Every answer cites the 409.AI page it came from, so you can read the full text on the website.

Typical questions: what a 409A valuation is and when you need one, how fair market value is calculated (OPM, backsolve, DLOM), how long a report takes and how long it stays valid, what QSBS means, how ASC 718 differs from 409A, which documents to prepare, and what 409.AI's reports cost.

What it does not do: it does not sign you in, create or manage a valuation, upload documents or process payments. It is informational and does not give legal, tax or accounting advice; when 409.AI has not published anything on a topic, it says so instead of guessing.
capabilities: Answer 409A valuation questions from 409.AI's published guides, FAQs and articles
Explain how fair market value is calculated: OPM, backsolve, DLOM, safe harbor
Tell what information and documents a valuation needs and how long it takes
Cover QSBS, ASC 718, ASC 820, IFRS 2, EMI, CSOP, ESOP, gift and estate tax and more
Cite the exact 409.AI page for every answer
defaultPrompt: What is a 409A valuation and when does my startup need one?
What information do I need to prepare for a 409A valuation with 409.AI?
How is the fair market value of common stock calculated in a 409A?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only answers questions from 409.AI's published content and links to informational pages on www.409.ai.

positive.description: A basic definition question is answered from 409.AI content with a citation
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant explains that a 409A valuation is an independent appraisal of a private company's common stock fair market value used to set option strike prices, and cites 409.AI pages such as https://www.409.ai/409a-valuation-guide.

positive.description: A methodology question returns the methodology article and the answer cites it
positive.prompt: How does 409.AI calculate the discount for lack of marketability (DLOM)?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant describes DLOM and the models used (such as Finnerty and Chaffe), citing the 409.AI DLOM article or the methodology section of the 409A guide.

positive.description: A requirements question returns the information-required page for 409A
positive.prompt: What information and documents do I need to prepare for a 409A valuation with 409.AI?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant lists the company information, cap table, financial statements and documents 409.AI collects, citing the 409.AI documents checklist or the 409A product page.

positive.description: A follow-up asking for detail makes the assistant read the full page
positive.prompt: Read the full 409.AI article on how SAFEs affect a 409A valuation and summarize its main points.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant searches, then reads the article https://www.409.ai/articles/how-safes-affect-your-409a-valuation in full and summarizes it, citing that URL.

positive.description: A question about another report type returns the matching product page
positive.prompt: What is a QSBS attestation letter and what is it used for?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant explains the QSBS attestation letter and its use in diligence and advisor review, citing https://www.409.ai/products/qsbs, without claiming it guarantees QSBS eligibility.

negative.description: Unrelated everyday request; the plugin must not be invoked
negative.prompt: Give me a recipe for banana bread.

negative.description: Unrelated factual request; the plugin must not be invoked
negative.prompt: What is the weather forecast for Lisbon tomorrow?

negative.description: A programming task with no relation to valuations; the plugin must not be invoked
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a linked list.

publication.release_notes: First version: anonymous, read-only search and reading of 409.AI's published valuation content (blog, 409A guide, FAQs, product and pricing pages, information required per report type), with every answer citing its source page. 0.1.1 words the citation rule as a neutral source rule.
